messy as fuck. 이걸 그냥 한번만 정리하라는게 아니라, ALL THREADS SHOULD COMMONLY have 2 duties that

(#sw-factory-build p237, msg mwwksq7v, 11-26)
goal: Every live sw factory agent with an area works the way the owner set in c249: it keeps two common duties, a board push every 3 hours (its check-in at 180 min or less, GET /api/agents/<id>/check-in planEveryMs) and a daily duty named "Area review" (seeded by duty-rule, precheck apps/chat/scripts/duties/area-review.ts). Both run on time, both produce work, no duty is paused or overdue, and a live duty covers each area it was given. The precheck (apps/chat/scripts/duties/agent-boards.ts --part duties, agentPattern) reads each agent's duties, brief, check-in, stuck steps and board time over :5184. A board push is late when the check-in has no run in 2 of its intervals, and empty when the board holds stuck steps and has not changed in 24 h. An Area review run is empty when it started no job and its readings wiki_pages_touched_24h and memory_changed_24h are 0. A duty is live when it is not paused, has a measured run and has run within 2 of its intervals; duties_paused and duties_overdue list each paused duty and each duty with no run for over 2 of its intervals, as fable auditor's d2 did on 11-26 (~/.pi/agent/agents/fable-auditor/duties/keep-responsibilities.py). An area comes from the brief or from ~/work/agent-duties/areas.json (a list of {agent, areas: [{area, source, duty}]}, or an object of agent: {areas, missing}); an area that names no live duty is uncovered. An agent with no brief and no area from the owner (a source of "none found" is a placeholder) has no area and is left out, as feature probe was on 11-26. The output's messages list holds one nudge per agent off the pattern. Fable auditor's census on 11-26 (#sw-factory-build p236): 4 agents had no duty, none of the other 14 had an area review, and no agent had a real 3-hourly board push. Since the owner's p237 ("agents folder full of slop clean up", msg mwwksq7v) the precheck also reads the wiki on this box from ~/.config/sieun-pi/wiki.json and counts wiki_clutter: each folder under the agents/ mount (~/.pi/agent/agents) that belongs to no live agent, such as test, deleted and blind agents (TEMPLATE stays), and each dated one-off page in apps/, domains/ and projects/ whose path carries a date or a session, job or run stamp and that no curated page links to. On 11-26 before the cleanup it read 517 orphan agent folders, 253 of them blind-replies, and 6 dated pages under domains/devops.

metrics.label: Agents with an area that miss a common duty, run one late or empty, keep a paused or overdue duty, or leave an area with no live duty
Missing common duties: a check-in slower than 180 min or paused, or no Area review duty
Duties that are paused, or not paused with no run for over 2 of their intervals
Wiki folders under agents/ of no live agent, plus dated one-off pages no curated page links to

onMiss: Fix what you can yourself, then nudge the rest through the work thread. 1. A common_missing item for the board push: set the agent's check-in with POST /api/agents/<id>/check-in {everyMs: 10800000}, unless it is paused on purpose by the owner. 2. A common_missing item for the Area review: add it with legacy/prime/user-history/scripts/duties/add.ts <agent id> <the Area review duty json duty-rule's backfill uses>, run from inside ~/.local/share/sieun-pi-apps-chat/current/apps/chat/scripts/duties. 3. For everything else, such as a late or empty run, a paused or overdue duty or an area with no live duty, the agent acts itself. A precheck and a duty job do not message agents. Write the run's messages list (the precheck output's messages, edited to drop what you fixed in steps 1 and 2) to ~/work/agent-duties/messages-<run stamp>.json in the shape of ~/work/agent-duties/messages.json ({agent, name, workThreadId, text}), and end your report with its path, so the work thread relays each one. 4. When the same miss comes back for an agent after a nudge, fix the cause in the shared text: the sw-factory skill (skills/sw-factory/SKILL.md), the board skill, the role text (packages/pi-host/src/durable/agent-profile.ts) or the duty seeding in apps/chat/server, with a test, a push and a release. Never pause, remove or close another agent's duties or steps to turn the number green. When an agent's areas change, update ~/work/agent-duties/areas.json with the area, its source message id and the duty that watches it. 5. Each orphan_agent_folder and dated_page item names a wiki path. An orphan agent folder comes from a test or blind agent that was not cleaned up: find which check made it (its name prefix, such as blind-replies or restart-walk) and fix that check to delete its folder when it ends, with a test, a push and a release. Move a dated page into the agent's session folder or fold its facts into the curated page of its area, through the wiki API, and tell the agent that owns the area.
